author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮಮಕಾರದಿಂದಲೇ ಶುರುವಹುದು ಜೀವನವು
ದಮನಿಸುತ ನಡೆಯುತಿರೆ ಬದುಕೆಂದು ಸಗ್ಗ
ಸಮನಾಗೆ ನರಕಕ್ಕೆ ನಾನೆಂಬ ಕತ್ತಲೆಯು
ತಮಕಳೆಯೆ ಬೆಳಕಿಹುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: if you walk on subduing it, life becomes heaven;
the darkness called ‘I’ is equal to hell;
dispel the darkness and there is light, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We are born attached. Restraining that attachment makes life heavenly; the darkness of ego is hell itself. Remove it, and light appears.
